en: Black-and-white postcard showing a formal garden with trimmed hedges, statues, a pond in the foreground, and a large classical-style manor or small palace centered in the background. The view is straight along a central axis through the garden towards the building. Small printed text at the bottom left identifies the location, and there is a circular publisher's mark with a number at the bottom right.
